prompt: Purchasing is buying a new bandsaw for the shop. No outside workers will be on our site and nothing is being outsourced — we just need the machine itself to arrive conforming to our OH&S requirements. Which ISO 45001 procurement sub-clause applies?
response:
Based on your scenario, **ISO 45001:2018 clause 8.1.4.2 — Procurement of goods** applies.

This sub-clause specifically covers purchasing **goods** (as opposed to 8.1.4.1 for contractors and 8.1.4.3 for outsourced processes). Since you're buying a bandsaw (a physical product/machine) with no external workers or outsourcing involved, this is a straightforward procurement of goods.

Key requirements under 8.1.4.2 include establishing and applying criteria to evaluate conformity to OH&S requirements **before** introducing goods into the workplace. For your bandsaw purchase, this would typically involve:

- Ensuring the machine meets applicable safety standards (guarding, emergency stops, noise levels, etc.)
- Verifying supplier documentation (manuals, risk assessments, conformity certificates)
- Confirming installation requirements are understood
- Planning for any commissioning/training needs

The standard requires you to communicate these criteria to your suppliers and verify that the goods meet them before use.
